new_sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: DTM archive covers site-specific surveys since 1998
raster data is available in 5km GeoTIFF zip files
elevations are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and aligned to OS Grid
resolution may be 25cm 50cm 1m or 2m
survey transformation/geoid must be taken from metadata for the actual intersecting survey
native CRS is EPSG:27700

coverage is all Great Britain
ASCII Grid and GML Grid are current grid formats

new_sources.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
facts: online download requires no registration
national tiled supply has 2858 10km tiles arranged in 55 100km folders
full national grid supply is approximately 157 MB compressed
full resupply is annual each July

new_sources.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data structure
facts: grid heights are calculated at the centre of each pixel
pixel-centre construction means no overlapping/common edge values between adjacent tiles
coordinate reference system is used to calculate DTM origin and individual posts
pixel-centre rule is mandatory for secondary numeric crosscheck
